environment.description: AWS Lambda (Python 3.9 runtime, x86_64) running as a Step Functions task in a VPC with no memory protections beyond default. Lambda execution role has secretsmanager:GetSecretValue on prod/database/credentials. The secret contains long-lived database credentials (rotated manually every 90 days). The Lambda function runs with 512MB memory and 5-minute timeout. No additional memory safety tooling or runtime hardening applied. An attacker who can trigger the double-free via repeated invocations can corrupt the Lambda sandbox heap, potentially leaking credential material from a subsequent allocation that reuses the freed chunk.
